Reference: transformers' Inkling2LoopForConditionalGeneration (modeling_inkling2_loop.py), its conversion mapping inkling2_loop / inkling2_loop_text (core_model_loading.py), and the published config.json. Fixture: $JITLLM_MODELS/synth-hf-inkling2 (scripts/inkling2gold.py); golden testdata/golden/inkling2/synth-hf-inkling2.json, which moves to testdata/golden/hf/ when the class converts (TestSafetensorsMatchTransformers reads that directory and would go red until then).

Placeholders name the piece that fills them: attend-bias (OpAttend's per-row, per-head additive score bias by backward distance), row-sinks (OpAttend's sinks per row from an input), row-taps (OpStateConv's per-row taps added to its static taps), loop (blocks of later passes sharing the first pass's weights, each pass its own history, the residual stream restarted from the pre-loop states), quant (NVFP4 and MXFP8 expert payloads), roles (new tensor roles in convert/tensornames.json).

describe.Inkling2LoopForConditionalGeneration: Inkling 2 Mini's text model, by convert/models/inkling2.json

notes: Key spellings, the class's attribute_map: sliding_window = sliding_window_size, num_local_experts = n_routed_experts, sconv_kernel_size = conv_kernel_size, model_max_length = max_position_embeddings, intermediate_size = moe_intermediate_size, routed_scaling_factor = route_scale. The published file and the fixture use the left-hand spellings for sconv_kernel_size, intermediate_size and model_max_length; a file stating both spellings differently is refused (RULE 7 bar 1).
loop_config {core_start, core_end, num_passes, gate_rank} overrides loop_layer_index_* where present (__post_init__); is_varloop true is not in the reference and is refused.

layer_types absent: 'hybrid' (full) where (i + 1) % 6 == 0, else 'hybrid_sliding' -- the CLASS's default, a literal 6 and not n_layers_per_attn_res_block. local_layer_ids is in the published file and the class never reads it; it is not the layer list. The fixture states layer_types.
hidden_act is in the config and the class never reads it: the experts' activation is the softcapped SwiGLU below whatever it says.
scoring_func other than sigmoid: the class reads ACT2FN[scoring_func], so softmax is not the same router; require sigmoid until a fixture covers another.
No rotary anywhere: positions reach the graph through the relative bias, the log scaling and the convolutions alone.
unpadded_vocab_size is the head's row count; the unembedding is stored padded to vocab_size and the class drops the padded rows on load.

require.else: Inkling 2's router is stated for sigmoid scores only
a variable loop count is not in the reference
the loop must start and end on an attention-residual block boundary (validate_architecture)

attention.head_count.int32s: each layer: hybrid_sliding -> swa_num_attention_heads, hybrid -> num_attention_heads

attention.head_count_kv.int32s: each layer: hybrid_sliding -> swa_num_key_value_heads, hybrid -> num_key_value_heads

attention.key_length.int32s: each layer: hybrid_sliding -> swa_head_dim, hybrid -> head_dim

attention.rel_extent.int32s: each layer: hybrid_sliding -> sliding_window_size, hybrid -> rel_extent

keys.PLACEHOLDER(roles): the int32s 'each layer' forms above are written as prose; kimi_linear.json's each_layer(...) is the form to follow, keyed on layer_types with the class default when it is null

model.model.llm.middle_cycle_cross_pass_querie: PLACEHOLDER(loop): (2 * loop layers, H), rows [2i, 2i+1] the query and MLP message queries of loop layer i
model.model.llm.middle_cycle_cross_pass_kv_que: PLACEHOLDER(loop): (2 * loop layers, H), rows [2i, 2i+1] the key and value message queries of loop layer i; every message query scaled by hidden_size ** -0.5 like the residual queries

per_layer_model_tensors.model.llm.attn_res.attn_queries.{i}: layer i + 1's attention-input queries (Inkling2IndexOffsetWeightRename offset 1; layer 0 has none and reads its input). A sliding layer's is (H): attn_res_score. A full layer's is (3, H): rows 0, 1, 2 the query, key and value inputs' queries -> attn_res_score_q, attn_res_score_k, attn_res_score_v (roles). Each scaled by hidden_size ** -0.5.
per_layer_model_tensors.model.llm.attn_res.mlp_queries.{i}: layer i's ffn_res_score, scaled by hidden_size ** -0.5
per_layer_model_tensors.PLACEHOLDER(roles): these are model-level names that belong to a block; a gather by index (the qwen3_5 'gather' form) or a block-level alias is owed

attn.k_sconv.static_w.why: (k, C), tap 0 the NEWEST row (the dynamic convolution's windows are flipped): to channel-major oldest-first, OpStateConv's order

attn.k_sconv.weight_proj.why: rows are (kv head, tap), tap 0 the newest

mlp.experts.w13_weight.why: w13's rows interleave gate and up (the mapping's Interleave(dim=1)): even rows gate, odd rows up

block.mlp.experts.w13_weight_scale: PLACEHOLDER(quant): NVFP4 (with _amax and _outer_scale_denominator: e2m1 codes two a byte, even element low nibble, an E4M3 scale per 16, a per-expert factor amax / denominator) or MXFP8 (without them: E4M3 values, a ue8m0 scale per 32); deinterleaved like w13
block.PLACEHOLDER(roles): attn_k_in_norm, attn_v_in_norm, attn_sinks_proj, attn_q_clip_scale, attn_rel, attn_rel_clip_scale, attn_rel_proj, attn_k_conv(_proj), attn_v_conv(_proj), attn_post_conv, ffn_post_conv, attn_res_score_{q,k,v}, loop_* are new roles; reuse an existing role wherever tensornames.json has one with the same meaning

notes: One block = one decoder layer. The loop unrolls: layers [0, start), then passes 1..P of layers [start, end), then [end, n). Pass p > 1's blocks share pass 1's weights (PLACEHOLDER(loop)) and each holds its own KV and convolution windows (the reference's cache_offset); the sequence of block STATES restarts at the pre-loop states each pass.

Residual stream = the attention-residual banks (latent_delta.json's streams, Kimi's): bank 0 the embedding output, one bank per block boundary (layer % B == 0) holding that layer's INPUT, and the running partial 'run'. Three departures from latent_delta's 'bank' def: the eps is 1e-6 (UnweightedRMSNorm's default, not rms_norm_eps); the score is q . rmsnorm(s) with q pre-scaled by H ** -0.5 at conversion; and the VALUES are the normed states (attn_res_normalize_values: the reference attends over the normed stack), so the def sums p_j * rmsnorm(@j), not p_j * @j.

Boundary layer (layer % B == 0): the bank receives the layer's input, and the residual after attention is the attention output ALONE (not input + attention); elsewhere input + attention. latent_delta's join_if/join states the same.

Full layers read three inputs (q, k, v) from the banks with three queries; sliding layers one. In passes > 1 every loop layer gates its q, k, v and MLP inputs with messages, so even a sliding loop layer's q, k, v inputs differ there.
All arithmetic below is f32 (the reference upcasts every step and the fixture's golden is f32).

block_outline.why: sliding: one query; layer 0 reads x itself (no attn_res_score)
full: three reads, attn_res_score_q/k/v; layer 0 full reads x for all three

block_outline.what: passes > 1: messages m_q, m_k, m_v, m_mlp = softmax over {previous pass's block states past the first loop bank, previous pass's final hidden} with this loop layer's four message queries (normed values, H ** -0.5), then for each of q/k/v: g = down([rmsnorm(h), rmsnorm(m)]) (rank), f = tanh(forget(g)), a = tanh(gain(g)), h' = (1 - f) * h + a * m. Sliding loop layer: h is ai for all three. All of it is rms_norm/concat/matvec/stated(tanh)/add: expressible; what is owed is the cross-pass source (a bank of the previous pass) and the shared weights

block_outline.why: sliding: nq = nk = nv (input_layernorm); full: q_input_norm, k_input_norm, v_input_norm on qi, ki, vi

block_outline.what: L2 clip per head: q * min(1, clip / (||q||_2 + 1e-6)); reduce(add of squares, Span head_dim) + map(sqrt) + stated: expressible (main loop's list)

block_outline.why: log scaling, full layers only: tau = 1 + alpha * log(max((pos + 1) / floor, 1)) on the clipped q and on the clipped relative states

block_outline.what: full layers: taps = static (attn_k_conv) + matvec(nk, attn_k_conv_proj) per row, one set of conv taps per kv head broadcast over its head_dim channels; scale 1 / sqrt(2 * conv + 1) instead of 1 / sqrt(conv + 1)

block_outline.why: the convolution's residual and scale; full layers sqrt(2 * conv + 1)

block_outline.what: k: unscaled L2 clip per head at the same clip
v's convolution (attn_v_conv / _proj), its residual and scale, then an UNWEIGHTED rms norm per head (eps rms_norm_eps): head_norm with no weight
r: attn_rel_clip_scale, L2 clip at rel_clip per head of rel_width; full layers the log scaling too

per head h and backward distance d in [0, extent): bias[h][d] = r[h] . attn_rel_proj[:, d], extent = sliding_window_size on sliding layers and rel_extent on full; zero at d >= extent. A matvec of r against attn_rel_proj gives the (heads, extent) table per row; OpAttend adds table[h][q_pos - k_pos] to the score after the 1/sqrt(head_dim) scale
OpAttend's sink logit per head from the row's 'sink' (softmax over [scores, sink], the sink's weight dropped), in place of a per-head weight

block_outline.why: scale head_dim ** -0.5, window sliding_window_size on sliding layers (q_pos - k_pos < window), causal full otherwise; plus the bias and the sinks above
boundary: bank <- x, run <- o; else run <- x + o

block_outline.what: passes > 1: fi = message gate (mlp) of fi with m_mlp

sigmoid scores of ffn_gate_inp (f32); top-k by score + exp_probs_b; weights the UNBIASED scores of the chosen, / (sum + 1e-20), * route_scale -- compressed.json's router ops with gate sigmoid, renormalise always, the 1e-20 as stated there

gate, up per chosen expert; act = softcap(gate, gate_softcap) * sigmoid(gate) * softcap(up, up_softcap), softcap(x, c) = c * tanh(x / c): stated over the two expert_matvec outputs; down; weighted; summed (compressed.json's expert ops with this act)

block_outline.why: y = residual + mlp, where residual is h (boundary: the attention output alone)

head_outline: final_input: the banks + run read with output_res_score (normed values), then output_norm, the head over unpadded_vocab_size rows, then final_logit_softcapping: c * tanh(x / c)
token_embd_norm: the embedding is RMS-normed with its weight (Inkling2LoopNormedEmbedding) before block 0 -- the front's input-row statement (convert/front.json) must state it
